system.description:
Trained in the Aldorethi tradition of the Silver Tower, or in the schools of Myllnoris and Eccria.

  • Elemental Precision: reroll 1s on the damage dice of your spells that deal elemental damage (once per die).
    • 9th level: reroll 1s and 2s.
  • Tower Theory: Advantage on Intelligence checks to recall magical theory and the history of the great schools.
